mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals monetary tightening, which reduces the present value of equity cash flows and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates an aggressive monetary policy stance that suppresses risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS threshold is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the labor market interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1400 thousand units signals continued consumer demand momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1400 in late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for HOUST threshold in late-cycle is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for INDPRO trend is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE threshold is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the demand interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it indicates accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL 12m change > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL threshold is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
